Operational Dynamics & Demand Cycles

Hourly and Day-of-Week Patterns

Operating volume follows a distinct corporate campus profile. Daily orders concentrate heavily in two peak windows: the Lunch Rush (12:30 PM to 2:30 PM) and Evening Snacks & Chai (4:00 PM to 6:00 PM). Demand drops sharply by 88% on Saturdays and 96% on Sundays due to corporate weekend closures.

Machine Learning Forecasting Engine & Production Projection

Branch 1 (Nirlon Knowledge Park) Backtest & 7-Day Forward Forecast

We evaluated 5 models using out-of-sample backtesting on 28 days of unseen test data. The LightGBM Regressor delivered the lowest error (MAE: 708 orders, 28.5% improvement over seasonal baseline) and an R² score of 0.8660.

Model Architecture MAE (Orders) RMSE (Orders) MAPE (%) R² Score Evaluation Status
LightGBM Regressor (Lag + Rolling Features) 708.05 1,529.18 20.43% 0.8660 Top Performing Model
Hybrid Ensemble (50% SARIMA + 50% LightGBM) 788.67 1,591.22 31.98% 0.8549 High Generalization
XGBoost Regressor 834.68 1,683.18 21.39% 0.8377 Solid Baseline
SARIMAX (1,1,1)(1,1,1)7 965.92 1,702.59 45.91% 0.8339 Seasonal Autoregressive
Seasonal Naive Baseline (Lag-7) 991.11 2,150.58 26.29% 0.7350 Reference Baseline

Strategic Business Recommendations

Operational & Revenue Optimization

Dynamic Kitchen Staff Scheduling

Align counter staffing directly with predicted order spikes (12:30–2:30 PM lunch and 4:00–6:00 PM snacks). Reduce weekend labor by 75% to lower overhead while eliminating weekday lunch bottlenecks.

Express Beverage Tap-and-Go Counters

Tea and coffee account for over 1.6M transactions annually. Segregating high-velocity beverages into automated QR dispensing counters will reduce main meal queue times by an estimated 30%.

Platinum VIP Retention & Subscriptions

The top 29.5% of diners drive 82.2% of platform revenue. Implementing corporate meal subscriptions and mobile pre-ordering with priority pickup will lock in core diner retention.

Predictive Inventory Procurement

Connect the 7-day LightGBM order forecast directly to dairy, bakery, and produce suppliers to automate daily purchase orders and eliminate food spoilage.
